study.question: Does the persistent reversal-averaging click AUC penalty enter through the five explicit history-summary channels, through grouped compression/scoring and its normalization population, or through their interaction?
study.hypothesis: The strongest joint model exposes order through two identifiable routes. The explicit summaries may carry oriented positional information that cannot be shared effectively between supplied and reversed views. If that route drives the observed penalty, replacing only the second-view summaries by their reversed counterparts should reproduce most of the both-route penalty while reversing only compression should not. The converse is a genuine competing prediction. This tests a local route explanation after per-view supervision failed to recover the reversal penalty; it is not a claim that all supplied chronology is necessary or that a new architecture is novel.

study.proposed_difference: A complete 2x2 factorial selects whether the SECOND view uses reversed or original raw (C) values/feedback-union/target-match-support tensors and (D) all five explicit global detail summaries. Raw supplied and reversed representations are always computed first. Context, target, original validity mask and permutation-invariant match counts stay inherited. The first view is always supplied. Selecting original route tensors duplicates the first half with differentiable concatenation. No parameter, label, event, RNG, normalization implementation or host recipe is added. Both-on is a bridge to reversal_per_view; neither-on is a bridge to supplied_per_view. Hybrids are deliberate combinations of authorized summaries and compression, not literal event permutations or fully order-invariant models.
predictions: Write A_CD for full-population validation click AUC. The previous paired gap A11-A00 is -0.0022122511546784. New bridges should reproduce its direction and approximate magnitude; native same-state bridge checks take precedence over numerical coincidence in AUC.
Under the explicit-summary hypothesis, A01-A00 is negative and accounts for most of A11-A00; A10-A00 is materially smaller. The competing compression-route hypothesis predicts the reverse ordering.
Compute interaction I=A11-A10-A01+A00. Large I relative to the main contrasts indicates that a single-route explanation is incomplete. Report every cell, including failures and negative outcomes.

Predeclare 0.0003 absolute click AUC as a practical comparison margin for later paired-seed/user-cluster uncertainty, not as a one-seed equivalence test. A claimed negligible route effect requires uncertainty bounded inside that margin.

All four models should retain 32192421 total/31793216 embedding/399205 dense trainable parameters. Runtime and peak memory remain near the prior 2B models, not the cheaper single-view incumbent; actual cost must be measured.
falsifiers: The summary-dominant explanation is falsified locally if the C-only penalty explains the both-route gap while the D-only penalty is negligible with adequate paired uncertainty.
If neither main contrast accounts for the gap and the factorial interaction is substantial, the proposed single-route explanation is unsupported.

If both bridges or event/mask alignment, current-target exclusion, padding preservation, source-gradient ownership, finite outputs/backward, parameter parity or train/eval state checks fail, no route mechanism inference is admissible.

Equal or better hybrid performance does not establish arbitrary-permutation invariance; even an order-invariant model matching the incumbent would only falsify useful supplied order under the tested recipe.
alternative_explanations: The compression route includes block membership, target-match normalization support, signed scoring, pooled bases and block nonlinear correction; this study cannot distinguish them.
The detail route contains all five summaries, including order-dependent centering and support gates, not only the coarse ordinal channels.
A hybrid representation can introduce a compatibility/optimization cost; factorial interaction does not by itself establish a biological or causal temporal mechanism.
Joint Dice batch statistics mediate route effects; the primary-source implementation confirms cross-row normalization.
One fixed training seed and finite precision do not establish significance or equivalence.

Reversing a valid sequence whose length is not a multiple of10 changes compression membership and the partial-block boundary. This is included in C, and differs from a pure signed-position intervention.

The older supplied/canonical local-duplicate contrast was approximately null while both were worse than the incumbent: removing coarse information can erase a gap by harming the reference, not by improving an invariant model.
Official offline historical feedback and frozen whole-window vocabularies limit point-in-time deployment conclusions. No timestamps, time gaps or unavailable events are assumed.

observations.interpretation: Supplied-order models beat several trained deterministic content canonicalizations. Single-view reversal is close to supplied, yet shared-weight reversal averaging loses about0.0022 click AUC against its duplicate control. Changing the BCE placement did not recover this penalty. These observations motivated route attribution; none establishes a general temporal mechanism. Repeated identity bridges are not independent seed replications. All trajectory-index execution statuses are success; poor predictive branches are negative scientific outcomes, not execution failures.
observations.latest_knowledge_reflection: The prior onetrans/mixformer cards were only considered; no unified backbone from those cards was executed. The per-view objective was the executed intervention and its reversal result remained worse. That is negative evidence about this implementation, not evidence against the external architectures. This proposal adopts no new industry method.

Verify routing table exactly: C selects indices2(values),4(auxiliary eligibility union),11(target-match support membership); D selects indices5..9(all five detail summaries). Context/target/validity/match-count tensors remain inherited. The compression mask must stay aligned and match counts remain invariant.

At identical learned parameters and cloned registered state, compare both-on with the archived reversal_per_view module and neither-on with supplied_per_view in train/eval, including outputs, per-view BCE, allowed/blocked gradients and exactly one native joint Dice state update. Account for finite-precision reduction changes; use host precision-appropriate predeclared tolerances, not a relaxed threshold inferred from desired AUC.

Check every trainable parameter is in the intended graph, no new parameters or buffers, unchanged construction/initialization order, strict checkpoint reload, loss-cache consumption/clear and no training-label use in forward.
